summary: Complete testing of 3 final P3 features for Culture Connect 2026 closing phase: 1) Real-time batch progress bar with job_id tracking, 2) Email send history with logs, 3) Advanced Dashboard Analytics for partner reports. All 14 backend API tests passed (100%). All 6 frontend features verified.

issues: Minor React hydration warning in console - span inside tbody (doesn't affect functionality)

backend: GET /api/registrations/batch/progress/{job_id} returns status, processed, sent, failed, progress_percent
GET /api/email-logs returns logs array with summary (total_sent, total_failed, badges_sent)
GET /api/v1/stats/advanced returns full analytics with KPIs
GET /api/v1/stats/advanced KPIs include: total_revenue_estimate, badges_sent, email_delivery_rate
GET /api/v1/stats/advanced tier_analysis includes revenue per tier
GET /api/v1/report/summary returns executive summary for presentations
GET /api/v1/report/summary key_metrics: inscriptions, approuves, partenaires, revenus_estimes
frontend: RAPPORT PARTENAIRES section visible with 4 metrics: Revenus Estimés (10,750€), Badges Envoyés (7), Taux Délivrabilité (100%), Demandes Stand (0)
'Voir rapport complet' link present linking to /api/v1/report/summary JSON
'Historique envois' button (data-testid='email-history-btn') opens modal with email logs
'Envoyer les badges à tous les approuvés (5)' button (data-testid='send-all-badges-btn') visible
Batch selection bar appears showing '1 sélectionné(s)' with 'Approuver la sélection' and 'Envoyer les badges sélectionnés' buttons
Progress bar component available for batch operations (Loader2 icon + progress tracking)

critical_code_review_comments: Batch jobs are stored in-memory (batch_jobs dict) - will be lost on server restart. Consider persisting to MongoDB for production reliability if long-running jobs are expected.
seed_data_creation: Created temporary test users (TEST_Progress User, TEST_Progress User 2) for testing batch progress endpoint, cleaned up after tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: 3 final P3 features fully implemented: 1) POST /api/registrations/batch/send-badges returns job_id, GET /api/registrations/batch/progress/{job_id} for polling (status: running|completed, processed, sent, failed, progress_percent), 2) GET /api/email-logs returns {logs, total_count, summary: {total_sent, total_failed, badges_sent}}, 3) GET /api/v1/stats/advanced returns full KPIs with revenue estimates, GET /api/v1/report/summary for executive presentations. Frontend AdminDashboard.jsx has: batchProgress state with polling, showEmailLogs modal, advancedStats section with RAPPORT PARTENAIRES.
